title: Why are you stronger in the evening? 🌇
caption:
Strength usually peaks in the late afternoon and evening, when body temperature is higher. But train in the morning often enough and your body adapts. Best time to train is the time you stick to. Morning or evening lifter? 👇

Why Does This Happen? #20
sources: Grgic J et al. The effects of time of day-specific resistance training on adaptations in skeletal muscle hypertrophy and muscle strength: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Chronobiol Int 2019;36:449-464
Mirizio GG et al. Time-of-day effects on short-duration maximal exercise performance. Sci Rep 2020;10:9485
Drust B et al. Circadian rhythms in sports performance: an update. Chronobiol Int 2005;22:21-44
